summary.text: Danny Ryan is a Democratic state representative from Boston who has represented the 2nd Suffolk District since April 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Public Service and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ryan, listed by Ballotpedia as Daniel Joseph Ryan, first won the seat in a 2014 special election and assumed office on April 16, 2014.
He is chair of the Joint Committee on Public Service.
